column1: # Tab-separated values (TSV) mapping local symlinks to external datasets.
# 1. link_name: Path provisioned inside raw_data/ OR repo-relative path if SYMLINK_DIR=.
# 2. relative_source_path: Path relative to $DATA_ROOT (or ROOT_NAME:path for secondary mounts)
# 3. relative_source_metadata_path: Path to checksum file relative to storage root
# 4. locked_hash: The cryptographic hash (MD5/SHA256) recorded from upstream
